rappel_detail.anchor: rappel ring anchor, with an old piton and oval nearby; inspect and back up
rappel_detail.station: Near the top of the route, above the chockstone chimney.
rappel_detail.notes: When reversing the couloir, rappel the chockstone chimney rather than downclimbing it with a pack; a single 60 m rope is enough. Then downclimb the couloir and descend open books and scree to Peggy's Pond.

set.rappels: 1 rappel down the chockstone chimney when reversing the couloir, on a single 60 m rope; or descend the Southwest Face with one or two rappels off a slung horn
set.rappel_count_note: Reversing the couloir takes one rappel, down the chockstone chimney. The other common way down, better for the trailhead, is the ordinary Southwest Face: one or two rappels off a rock horn with fixed slings and rings, then downclimb the main gully to Cathedral Pass.
